statement: Build a single-file, dark and modern portfolio website for a frontend developer that helps visitors hire them as a freelancer, with placeholder content for now.
audience: Potential freelance clients looking to hire a frontend developer.
standards: Dark, modern look: dark background with light text and readable contrast
Works on phones (360px wide) and desktop (1280px wide) with no sideways scrolling
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
No JavaScript errors, and every in-page link points to a section that exists
rules: Use clearly marked dummy content for the name, projects, email address and profile links until real ones are supplied
Contact is by an email link plus profile links only, with no contact form
Do not invent real personal facts such as a real email address or real profile URLs
done_when: The page shows a placeholder developer name as the main heading, with a short line saying they are a frontend developer available for freelance work
A projects section shows 3 project cards, each with a title and a one-line description
A contact section has an email link (mailto) and links to GitHub and LinkedIn
The page has a visible call-to-action button for hiring or working together that links to the contact section
The page uses a dark background with light text, set in the CSS
The file has a viewport meta tag and responsive CSS, and no element forces horizontal scrolling at 360px or 1280px
The file contains no contact form, no JavaScript errors, and every in-page link points to an existing section id

to_be_confirmed.criterion: The page shows a placeholder developer name as the main heading, with a short line saying they are a frontend developer available for freelance work
to_be_confirmed.fact: The real name to show on the site

to_be_confirmed.fact: The real 2 to 4 projects, each with a title and one-line description
